name: bos
description: Agent-first Business Operating System foundations for governed agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Agent-first Business Operating System foundations for governed agent workflows.
interface.longDescription: BOS is an agent-first Business Operating System for planning, implementing, reviewing, governing, and executing agent-ready business operations. BOS owns the root authenticated MCP connection, resolves the selected organization, and discovers its authorized installed applications. GPT uses current server-returned app contacts and contracts for per-app routing while the existing BOS domain-tool gateway remains migration compatibility state.
defaultPrompt: List the BOS apps and skills installed for my organization.
Show me the tools and workflows available in each BOS app.
Check which BOS apps are connected and ready to use.
